bugs.error_message: CAN frame '0xFF [03] 28 00 00' decoded as SwitchMode instead of WriteRegUint8
bugs.root_cause: SwitchMode had broadcast_node_id: 0x7F (giving it ID 0xFF), but WriteRegUint8 did not — making SwitchMode the only candidate for 0xFF regardless of DLC. Codec also didn't guard against calling decode_broadcast when data was too short for concatenated payload.
bugs.fix: 1) Added broadcast_node_id: 0x7F to WriteRegUint8 in example_damiao.yaml so it appears as a candidate for 0xFF. DLC preference (3==3) then correctly selects it over SwitchMode (dlc=4). 2) In Codec.decode(), added size check before calling decode_broadcast: only use concatenated decode when len(data)==dlc*node_count, otherwise fall through to single-frame decode.

bugs.error_message: RegResponseByte register_id filter not working — all RegResponse* frames decoded as RegResponseFloat32
bugs.root_cause: findMessageById returned the first multi-node message matching the CAN ID, without considering DLC. RegResponseFloat32, RegResponseByte, RegResponseWord etc. all share base ID 0x100 — the first registered one always won, so register_id enum filter on RegResponseByte had no effect.
bugs.fix: Updated findMessageById to accept optional dlc parameter. Collects all candidates and prefers the one with matching DLC, matching the Python codec's _find_message_by_id behavior. decode() now passes data.length as dlc.

bugs.error_message: RegResponseByte filter still not working after DLC fix — node 0 frames always decoded as first registered RegResponse variant
bugs.root_cause: rebuildLookups() added multi-node messages to byId with their base ID. findMessageById hit the byId fast-path for node-0 frames (base ID = 0x100) and returned immediately WITHOUT checking DLC. The DLC disambiguation in the multiNodeMessages loop was never reached for base-ID frames.
bugs.fix: Changed rebuildLookups to only add single-node messages (node_count <= 1) to byId. Multi-node messages are only tracked in multiNodeMessages, ensuring ALL lookups go through the DLC-aware candidate selection.

bugs.error_message: Multi-frame MAVLink decode garbled when two messages interleave
bugs.file: canfd_codec/mavlink_loader.py, monitor.py, cli.py, codec.py; web/src/lib/codec.ts, plot-store.svelte.ts
bugs.root_cause: Existing reassembly grouped consecutive same-canId frames OR kept one buffer per canId. Interleaved messages either failed to group (paste) or appended continuation frames to the wrong buffer (live). Python monitor/cli had no multi-frame reassembly.
bugs.fix: Added MavlinkReassembler (Py+TS) with FIFO concurrent buffers per canId and length-based completion (12+payload_len). Wired into Python monitor/cli (multi-data args) and web analyze/handleLiveFrame. Added Codec.decode_mavlink for msg_id-based lookup.

bugs.error_message: /decode page still garbled multi-frame MAVLink after reassembler fix
bugs.root_cause: The /decode page had its OWN grouping logic separate from plot-store: it grouped ALL consecutive same-canId MAVLink frames into one buffer, then called smartDecodeMultiFrame on the concatenated bytes — lumping multiple back-to-back messages on the same canId into one giant pseudo-frame.
bugs.fix: Rewrote decode() to feed frames through MavlinkReassembler with length-based completion, same as the plot-store paste analyzer. Tracks per-canId raw line lists to preserve the source-line label for each reassembled group.
